```{r}
library(knitr)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(psych)
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}
# Load your data
CaffeineData = read.table("Lab7_Caffeine.csv",
                          sep = ",",
                          header = T)
```

```{r}
# Set the categoical variable to be a 'factor' for R to calculate properly.
CaffeineData$caffeine = factor(CaffeineData$caffeine)
```

```{r}

# "contr.sum" is the correct option for typle type III SS
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
# "contr.treatment" is a reference group type contrast closer to a type I or
# type II SS.
#options(contrasts = c("contr.treatment", "contr.poly"))

leveneTest(accuracy_scores ~ caffeine, data = CaffeineData)

model = lm(accuracy_scores ~ caffeine, CaffeineData )

summary(model)

a = Anova(model, type = 3)
kable(a)

# Bonferroni correct multple t-tests
a = emmeans(model, pairwise ~ caffeine, adjust = "bonferroni")
a$contrasts %>% kable()

# Equivanlent to LSD
a = emmeans(model, pairwise ~ caffeine, adjust = "none")
a$contrasts %>% kable()

# Tukey
a = emmeans(model, pairwise ~ caffeine, adjust = "tukey")
a$contrasts %>% kable()

```
